## 📋 Pull Request Description | PR 描述

### 🎯 What does this PR do? | 这个 PR 做了什么？

A clear and concise description of what this pull request accomplishes.
清晰简洁地描述这个拉取请求完成了什么。

### 🔗 Related Issues | 相关问题

Fixes #(issue number) | 修复 #(问题编号)
Closes #(issue number) | 关闭 #(问题编号)
Relates to #(issue number) | 与 #(问题编号) 相关

### 🔄 Type of Change | 更改类型

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) | 错误修复（修复问题的非破坏性更改）
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) | 新功能（添加功能的非破坏性更改）
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) | 破坏性更改（会导致现有功能无法按预期工作的修复或功能）
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update | 文档更新
- [ ] 🎨 Style/UI change | 样式/UI更改
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring | 代码重构
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement | 性能改进
- [ ] 🧪 Test addition/update | 测试添加/更新

### 🧪 How Has This Been Tested? | 如何测试？

Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.
描述您运行的测试以验证您的更改。

- [ ] Unit tests | 单元测试
- [ ] Integration tests | 集成测试
- [ ] Manual testing | 手动测试
- [ ] Browser testing | 浏览器测试

**Test Configuration | 测试配置:**
- Go version: | Go版本：
- Database: | 数据库：
- OS: | 操作系统：

### 📸 Screenshots | 截图

If applicable, add screenshots to show the changes.
如果适用，请添加截图以显示更改。

**Before | 之前:**
<!-- Add screenshot here -->

**After | 之后:**
<!-- Add screenshot here -->

### 📋 Checklist | 检查清单

#### Code Quality | 代码质量
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project | 我的代码遵循此项目的样式指南
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code | 我已对自己的代码进行了自我审查
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas | 我已注释了我的代码，特别是在难以理解的区域
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings | 我的更改不会产生新的警告

#### Testing | 测试
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works | 我已添加证明我的修复有效或我的功能有效的测试
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes | 新的和现有的单元测试在我的更改下本地通过
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published | 任何依赖的更改都已合并和发布

#### Documentation | 文档
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation | 我已对文档进行了相应的更改
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG.md | 我已更新了 CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] I have added/updated API documentation if applicable | 如果适用，我已添加/更新了API文档

#### Database Changes | 数据库更改
- [ ] No database schema changes | 无数据库架构更改
- [ ] Database changes are backward compatible | 数据库更改向后兼容
- [ ] Migration scripts are included | 包含迁移脚本
- [ ] Database changes have been tested | 数据库更改已测试

### 🔍 Additional Notes | 其他说明

Add any additional notes, concerns, or questions for reviewers.
为审查者添加任何其他说明、关注点或问题。

### 📊 Performance Impact | 性能影响

- [ ] No performance impact | 无性能影响
- [ ] Performance improved | 性能改进
- [ ] Performance may be affected (explain below) | 性能可能受到影响（请在下面解释）

<!-- Explain any performance implications -->

### 🔒 Security Considerations | 安全考虑

- [ ] No security implications | 无安全影响
- [ ] Security improved | 安全性改进
- [ ] Potential security impact (explain below) | 潜在安全影响（请在下面解释）

**Security details | 安全详情:**
<!-- Explain any security implications -->

### 🌍 Deployment Notes | 部署说明

Any special deployment considerations or steps required.
任何特殊的部署考虑或所需步骤。

- [ ] No special deployment steps | 无特殊部署步骤
- [ ] Environment variables need to be updated | 需要更新环境变量
- [ ] Database migration required | 需要数据库迁移
- [ ] Configuration changes required | 需要配置更改
